Derryn Hinch, a long-time Australian media figure and former senator, has passed away at 82, leaving behind a legacy of loud, opinionated broadcasting.

The Poison:
His methods often prioritized his own brand over the stability of the legal processes he claimed to defend.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the Logical plane (HOW); he bypassed legal channels to achieve 'justice', creating systemic instability.

Social Physics Analysis:
He operated on a loop of provocation and justification. By framing his law-breaking as a moral crusade, he projected his personal need for attention onto the public's desire for justice.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. His personal brand often obscured the actual legal outcomes.

The Unavoidable Truth: He brought attention to issues others ignored.

The Unavoidable Lie: His actions were purely motivated by altruism.

He was a master of the 'Smart Selfish Loop'. He understood that in the media, being loud is more profitable than being right.
